errors.text_span: 第一个饼图被分为8个切片
errors.evidence: The first pie chart actually has 9 slices, not 8. The description misses the slice '司法' (Judicial) which is also part of the first pie chart and has a value of 10.64% according to the legend and its color. The machine description seems to have miscounted the slices and missed one.

The description incorrectly merges two distinct slices, '生理活动' (Physiological Activity, 9.48%) and '文教' (Culture/Education, 5.57%), into a single category '生理活动文教' and assigns the percentage of only the first one.
The description incorrectly identifies the slice '文教' (Culture/Education) as '文化' (Culture). These are related but distinct terms, and the chart uses '文教'.
The description incorrectly states that there is no legend. A comprehensive legend is clearly visible on the right side of the figure.

errors.text_span: 第二个饼图被分为11个切片
errors.evidence: The second pie chart has 10 slices, not 11. The description lists 10 categories, which contradicts its own claim of 11 slices.
The chart label is '争斗', but the description uses the synonym '斗争'. While the meaning is very similar, it is not the exact term used in the chart.

The description fails to mention that the second pie chart is an exploded view or a breakdown of the '其他' (Other) category from the first pie chart, which is a key structural feature indicated by the connecting lines.
